headline: US and Iran signal peace deal is close to end war
summary: Pakistan-brokered talks have led to a draft agreement involving sanctions relief and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.
details: The United States and Iran have signalled that an agreement to end their conflict is close, with a senior US official stating that a text both sides find acceptable is now in place.

Pakistan, which has spent weeks brokering the deal, announced that a final text of the peace agreement has been reached. Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif confirmed that Pakistan is working with both nations to finalise the next steps.
Leaked terms of the proposed memorandum of understanding suggest the deal may favour Iran, leading US President Donald Trump to dismiss the reports as inaccurate.
A senior US administration official clarified that the deal specifically requires the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, which Iran had closed following attacks by the US and Israel in February.
The agreement also includes the removal of enriched nuclear material. In return, Iran is expected to receive significant sanctions relief based on its performance under the terms of the deal.
caption:
A peace deal between the US and Iran is reportedly close. Pakistan has brokered a final text to end the war.

The United States and Iran have signalled that an agreement to end their conflict is close, with a senior US official stating that a text both sides find acceptable is now in place.

Pakistan, which has spent weeks brokering the deal, announced that a final text of the peace agreement has been reached. Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif confirmed that Pakistan is working with both nations to finalise the next steps.

Leaked terms of the proposed memorandum of understanding suggest the deal may favour Iran, leading US President Donald Trump to dismiss the reports as inaccurate.

A senior US administration official clarified that the deal specifically requires the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, which Iran had closed following attacks by the US and Israel in February.

The agreement also includes the removal of enriched nuclear material. In return, Iran is expected to receive significant sanctions relief based on its performance under the terms of the deal.

headline: Two children drown in Padma River while playing near the bank
summary: Tragedy strikes as two young lives are lost to the waters of the Padma River. The children were playing near the riverbank when the incident occurred.
details: Two children have tragically drowned in the Padma River. The incident occurred while they were playing near the riverbank, a common area for local children.
Emergency services were alerted, but by the time they arrived, it was too late to save the young victims. The community is in shock and mourning the loss.

The Padma River, while a vital waterway, poses significant risks due to its strong currents and unpredictable nature. Authorities often warn residents, especially parents, about the dangers of playing near its banks.
